crossRefs.note: For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
“ ‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh…
All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever…
Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of…
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

translations.web: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’ ”
translations.bsb: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.”
translations.kjv: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless
translations.asv: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, the vine, and the fig-tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive-tree have not brought forth; from this day will I bless you.
